'''Phattro''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink sold in bottles in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and diners, like [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]], [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] and [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]]. The name was printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the label. It was advertised on posters in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Phattro was part of an advertisement campaign that included travel advertisements for [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Posters featuring the three were put up on walls in a repeating pattern near a [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxi]] station. Advertisements for Phattro were also found in other parts of the underworld.
